description:
This is a wide, multi-lane curved road with fast-moving traffic and no clearly visible pedestrian crossing; separation from vehicles is limited to curbs, with no protected buffer or barrier for walkers. Sidewalks are minimal or unclear on the left due to a dirt/construction-like shoulder, while on the right there appears to be a narrow paved path behind a curb, but continuity and accessibility features such as curb ramps are not evident.

There is substantial greenery and some tree cover along the right side, which may provide limited shade, and streetlights are present. Obstacles and comfort issues include parked cars on the shoulder, traffic cones, and a generally auto-oriented roadway environment that appears less comfortable for pedestrians.
